mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Temperatures are a comfortable 70 degrees with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. We are currently under a waning gibbous moon, and if you look to the northwest near Verona High School at 3:29 AM, you can catch the International Space Station passing by as it travels toward the northeast near Home Depot.

Verona is officially observing September 2026 as Hunger Action Month. Mayor Luke Diaz issued this proclamation to address systemic food insecurity, noting that 1 in 8 residents in Southwest Wisconsin face these challenges. The city is encouraging community-wide collaboration, volunteering, and donations to help close the nutrition gap.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona. Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Tomorrow, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, or Dream Day Trivia at Paddy Mac's. Looking further ahead, Paddy Mac's features live music on September 2, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market is at Hometown Junction Park on September 2, and there is trivia at The Bogey Factory also on September 2.

In a noteworthy update from the weekly police report, an incident occurred on August 23 at 1:54 AM, where a 17 year old was cited for absolute sobriety and an 18 year old was cited for underage drinking.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle Dove. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:00 PM.
